facts.fact: The ANINF (Agence nationale des infrastructures numériques et des fréquences) is stated to provide protection, supervision and resilience of the digital infrastructures in its perimeter, with security-event analysis, forensics, isolation and restoration support, and to have been approached by public bodies for audits and investigations in recent months.

ANINF's nine-page dossier to newsrooms addresses the figure of over 900,000 alerts recorded in two months on its supervised perimeter (the figure first given by the government); the period's end date is not stated, so the publication date is used.
